results.description:
The brand new Miss Marple novel from Lucy Foley, the No.1 bestselling author of The Guest List and The Midnight Feast.

‘As continuation novels go, this one – the first to feature Miss Marple – is top-notch. [Foley] is an excellent writer’ The Times

'With twists and red herrings aplenty, this is a fabulous evolution of an old favourite' Heat

'a fun and fast-paced whodunnit with plenty of drama' ELLE

'Lucy Foley is a master of her craft. She always leaves you guessing until the last page' Freida McFadden

'So clever, atmospheric, and thrilling! Foley has absolutely nailed Miss Marple’ Shari Lapena

***

High in the Swiss Alps, with glorious mountain views and exclusive access to powdery slopes, the Grand Alpine Hotel draws guests from far and wide.

The notorious actress

The high-flying politician

The inscrutable political wife

The reckless friend

The shrewd doctor

But when a guest enters a gondola alive, only to be found dead at the top of the mountain, it’s clear there’s a killer in their midst.

As tensions rise, and old grudges emerge like cracks in the ice, someone watches from the shadows. An unassuming woman with an extraordinary mind: Miss Marple.

She suspects everyone in the hotel, and she’s right to. For it isn’t just a question of who has a motive, but who’s next…

Arriving 50 years after Agatha Christie’s last MISS MARPLE novel was published, Lucy Foley's Murder at the Grand Alpine Hotel is a landmark event.

‘So clever and so much fun’ Marian Keyes

'Such a clever writer' Anthony Horowitz

'I couldn't put it down!' Bonnie Garmus

'The clever twists would make Agatha Christie proud’ Claire Douglas

‘A joy to be back with Miss Marple in this expertly crafted novel’ Clare Leslie Hall

‘Masterful, murderous fun’ Chris Whitaker

‘This was a golden age joy from start to finish’ Andrea Mara

‘Will keep you guessing until the end’ Alice Feeney

About the author

Lucy Foley is a life-long Agatha Christie fan, and Miss Marple is her favourite Christie creation. Lucy was one of twelve writers who contributed to Marple, a collection of short stories featuring the beloved detective. And in Murder at the Grand Alpine Hotel, she transports Miss Marple to the glamorous post-war setting of the Swiss Alps, in a mystery that feels gloriously escapist yet utterly relevant to our times. Lucy is a No.1 Sunday Times and New York Times bestselling author, whose contemporary murder mystery thrillers have sold over 10 million copies worldwide. She is a three-time nominee at the British Book Awards, winner of the Goodreads Choice Award for Best Mystery Thriller, and several of her novels are currently being adapted for the screen.
